description:
Passes a fan's correction of one of UPFRONT's facts to a person at
UPFRONT to check: "section 112 has 18 rows, not 17", "the bag
policy changed, backpacks are allowed now", "gates open at 5:30".
It is for corrections the user gives or asks to send to UPFRONT.

kind: one of "rows" (rows or seats in a section), "view", "section"
(its name or where it is), "bags", "entry", "parking", "transit",
"food", "other".
venue: the venue's name. section, row: when it's about one.
claim: what the fan says is right, in their words, with what
UPFRONT said if known (under 1,000 characters).
source: how the fan knows ("sat there on Oct 12", a link), if they
said.

Nothing on UPFRONT changes until a person checks it: the correction
is passed on, not fixed. Every request files a separate report.
name: report_fact
title: Report a wrong fact
